title: Why Was Jesus Born in Bethlehem?
thread: About 700 years before Jesus, the prophet Micah named a small town, Bethlehem, as the birthplace of a promised King, and the same verse says "from everlasting": Bethlehem was His birthplace, not His beginning (Micah 5:2); Jesus was born there (Matthew 2:1; Luke 2:4-7); wise men came to Jerusalem asking where the King was, and Herod asked the Bible experts, who answered from the prophet: Bethlehem (Matthew 2:1-11); the Bible never says the experts went, the wise men went and found the child; Jesus grew up in Galilee and people argued the King could not come from there, but the promise said Bethlehem and He was born there (John 7:41-43); Jesus came much farther, down from heaven (John 6:38), died for our sins and rose on the third day (1 Corinthians 15:3-4)
